card.name: The word and after central sleep apnea (CSA)
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "central sleep apnea (CSA)" in opioid warnings about sleep-related breathing disorders. Weakly also "dioxide" in "Carbon dioxide (CO 2) retention".

modes.label: and after CSA
modes.description: The linking word "and" after the abbreviation CSA, just before "sleep-related hypoxemia".
modes.example: Opioids can cause sleep-related breathing disorders including central sleep apnea (CSA)<< and>> sleep-related hypoxemia.

modes.label: Carbon dioxide
modes.description: The word "dioxide" in "Carbon dioxide retention" in the opioid respiratory-depression text.

card.plain: It marks the "and" in the standard opioid sentence on sleep apnea and low blood oxygen.
